binders: fp is an arbitrary LocalDef002 package. Write u for fp.1 and fl_add for fp.3.
r is an arbitrary natural number, including zero.
v is an arbitrary real vector indexed by Fin(2^r), hence with exactly 2^r components v_0,...,v_(2^r-1).
hypotheses: For every pair of reals x,y, there exists a real delta depending on that pair such that |delta| <= u and fl_add(x,y)=(x+y)(1+delta).
The explicit validity hypothesis is (2^r-1)u < 1, with 2^r-1 a natural number cast to the reals.
conclusions: For the balanced pairwise result P_r(v), |P_r(v)-sum_i v_i| <= gamma_r(u) sum_i |v_i|.
For the sequential left-to-right result Q_(2^r)(v), |Q_(2^r)(v)-sum_i v_i| <= gamma_(2^r-1)(u) sum_i |v_i|.
mathematical_definitions: gamma_n(u) = (n u)/(1-n u), where n is embedded exactly into the reals.
S(v) = sum over every i in Fin(2^r) of v_i, computed with exact real addition.
L(v) = sum over every i in Fin(2^r) of |v_i|, also computed exactly in the reals.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every nonnegative local relative-error parameter u, every binary real operation fl_add satisfying exact left addition by zero and the per-operation model fl_add(x,y)=(x+y)(1+delta) for some pair-dependent delta with |delta|<=u, every natural r, and every real vector of length 2^r, if (2^r-1)u<1, then the fixed balanced binary reduction has absolute forward error at most gamma_r(u) times the exact sum of component magnitudes, the fixed left-to-right reduction has absolute forward error at most gamma_(2^r-1)(u) times that same quantity, and gamma_r(u) is no larger than gamma_(2^r-1)(u).

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The theorem only treats vector lengths that are powers of two.
The implication is vacuous for any fp and r for which (2^r-1)u<1 is false.
Natural subtraction is truncated in Lean, but 2^r>=1, so the occurrence 2^r-1 has its ordinary mathematical value.
The validity condition makes 1-(2^r-1)u positive. Together with u>=0 and r<=2^r-1, it also makes 1-r u positive.

The balanced reduction uses the fixed contiguous first-half/second-half tree and preserves operand order. The sequential reduction is the fixed left fold. No bound for arbitrary association or permutation is asserted.
No commutativity, associativity, or exact right-zero identity is assumed for fl_add.
The local witness delta may vary with x and y; no common witness, independence, sign rule, or probabilistic model is encoded.
The local relative-error equation forces fl_add(x,y)=0 whenever x+y=0.
The bounds are absolute forward-error bounds scaled by sum_i |v_i|, not relative-error bounds with respect to |sum_i v_i|.
All exact sums, absolute values, products, quotients, and gamma constants in the proposition are real quantities, not further rounded computations.
No finite representable set, rounding mode, overflow, underflow, subnormal behavior, infinities, NaNs, or input representability condition is encoded.
At r=0 the vector has one entry, both algorithms return that entry without applying fl_add, both gamma constants are gamma_0(u)=0, and the validity hypothesis is automatic.
